the banner before the first question. With a conversation it is that conversation's, built by
the same function.

Needs a session like every assistant route, but reads nothing of the tenant's, so it takes
no transaction: only the short session lookup.

Nothing but the denial's note comes from the client. A proposal the engine refuses at
confirm time is a 200 with status `failed` and the reason: the confirm itself worked.

AssistantTextsOut.title: AssistantTextsOut
AssistantTextsOut.description:
The fixed refusals the composer shows before a request is sent, so the web app holds no
copy of the words.

BudgetBannerOut.title: BudgetBannerOut
BudgetBannerOut.description: The fixed text for the cap that stops the person: the sandbox's, or the day's.

BudgetOut.title: BudgetOut
BudgetOut.description:
Whether a turn can start. A cap counts as reached when it has less than a turn needs left,
not only at zero (the 429 uses the same measure).

CalendarOut.title: CalendarOut
CalendarOut.description: The date picker's marks for the signed-in person.

CancelCard.title: CancelCard
CancelCard.description: A card to cancel a request of the person's own.

CheckOut.title: CheckOut
CheckOut.description:
The engine's answer for a possible request. It is a preview: nothing was written, and it is
a 200 even when the request has problems.

CitationOut.title: CitationOut
CitationOut.description: A citation as the `citation` event sent it.

ConfirmIn.title: ConfirmIn
ConfirmIn.description:
The body of a confirm. A denial's note is the only thing the client sends: the proposal's
action, payload, and person are the server's own, so any other field is a 422.

CoverageOut.title: CoverageOut
CoverageOut.description: One colleague who is off on some of the request's days. Plain context, never a verdict.

DecideCard.title: DecideCard
DecideCard.description: A card to approve or deny a request, for its person's direct manager.

DirectoryFacets.title: DirectoryFacets
DirectoryFacets.description:
The counts behind the directory's header and filter menus.

An option's count is how many people the list would show if that option were chosen, with
every other active filter kept. Every location and department is listed, even at zero.

EscalationOut.title: EscalationOut
EscalationOut.description: The fixed text the stream's `escalation` event had, and the HR team to reach.

FailureOut.title: FailureOut
FailureOut.description:
Why a confirmed proposal didn't go through: the engine's or the service's code, and its one
fixed sentence. `dates` is the days that clash, for `overlaps` only.

FieldError.title: FieldError
FieldError.description: One failed field on a 422: where it was, what was wrong, and the error's kind.

GuardOut.title: GuardOut
GuardOut.description: What the safety check decided. Its injection flag stays on the server.

Me.title: Me
Me.description: The signed-in person's own card, with the fields only they see.

PossibleRequest.title: PossibleRequest
PossibleRequest.description: The body of a check and of a request: type, dates, and a partial amount for a single day.

Problem.title: Problem
Problem.description: The body of every error response. Only a 422 has `errors`.

RequestCard.title: RequestCard
RequestCard.description: A card to book PTO or record sick time.

SectionLink.title: SectionLink
SectionLink.description: A neighbor in the handbook's order.

SectionRef.title: SectionRef
SectionRef.description: A related section: the one an addendum supplements, or an addendum that supplements one.

SectionSummary.title: SectionSummary
SectionSummary.description: A section as the list, the search results, and the section and passage headers show it.

TurnErrorOut.title: TurnErrorOut
TurnErrorOut.description: The code the stream's `error` event had, and its fixed text.
